verdict.rationale: Aircall's API reference documents per-call endpoints to retrieve a transcription, summary, sentiments and topics, which shows AI transcripts and summaries are generated and tied to each call. The homepage also says AI Assistants capture notes and update CRM records automatically, keeping interactions connected in one place. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how summaries and transcripts appear on the conversation in the app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
